blog.title: My Own Lightweight CMS Magic! 🚀✨
blog.content:
I love my portfolio website, but updating it was becoming a bit of a chore. Since it's a completely static website and hosted in github pages, all my blog posts and project details are stored in static JSON files inside the repo. To make my life easier, I decided to build a custom editor app to handle all my updates on the fly! ✍️💻

This app is a total game-changer! It lets me easily post blogs and add new projects without touching code. Plus, I integrated ImgBB and Giphy to handle all my media assets. The app uploads my images and videos, grabs the URLs, and even automatically converts videos into lightweight GIFs! 🎬🍿 All of these links are then instantly injected right into my static JSON data.

The result? A super fast, lightweight website that I can update in seconds! 🍃 No heavy databases or clunky backend setups—just pure static speed combined with the absolute joy of a seamless, custom-built CMS. I couldn't be happier! 🎉🙌

blog.title: The Foreman Philosophy
blog.content: Give a man with no knowledge of building a house the best tools, and give a foreman the same tools. Who builds the house? Now, give the foreman a manual saw and the novice an electrical saw. The foreman still wins. My knowledge of structure is what makes me a great developer; AI is simply my power tool.
